concerns.text: The plan cites OpenML dataset ID 42123 as the primary source for surface‑roughness and tribology measurements, but no verified URL or citation is provided and the OpenML catalogue does not contain a dataset with those exact columns (Sa, Sq, Ssk, Sku, Sp, Sv, coeff_friction, wear_rate). Using a dataset that lacks the required features would make the entire pipeline unable to meet the functional requirements (FR‑001, FR‑012) and the success criteria (SC‑001/SC‑002). Provide a verified, publicly reachable dataset that explicitly includes the needed roughness descriptors and target variables, or adjust the requirements to match the actual content of the OpenML dataset.
